items.question: What state word does a spec with documents get when it is not live, closed, deferred or next?
options: Add a sixth word, "stopped", with the phase it stopped in
Keep five words and show it as "not started"

items.question: Do Specs and Deferrals group by spec store or by registered project?
options: One block per spec store (the two tradr projects share one)
One block per enabled project (same store listed twice)

items.question: How is a run's utilisation per task measured for the fit line?
options: Per-run attribution: positive steps on log lines carrying the run's id
Window delta since the run started (counts other runs' spend)

items.question: How is the 24 h burn computed from the usage log?
options: Sum of positive steps over the last 24 h; "not known yet" until the log reaches back 24 h
Plain difference of the two lines 24 h apart
Same over a shorter span with its length shown

items.question: What is the money, personal-data-and-erasure, and legal/compliance posture (refunds and forfeiture, credits, legal framing)?
options: n/a — the spec touches no money, personal data, or legal surface
items.basis: Checked: no billing, payments, refunds or credits code; Resolve updates a deferral record's status and text (no deletion of user data); the usage log holds a timestamp, a utilisation number and a run id (no personal data); deleted items are dashboard routes and components, not stored data.
